record.context_brief: Birational categorical Torelli for Gushel-Mukai threefolds
record.original_question: Let X1 and X2 be prime Fano threefolds of index 1 and degree 10, so in particular Gushel-Mukai threefolds. If there is a Fourier-Mukai type equivalence Phi: Ku(X1) -> Ku(X2), must X1 and X2 be birational?

evidence.quote: Question 5.34 ([67], Question 1.1(1)). Let X1 and X2 be prime Fano threefolds of index 1 and degree 10. Assume that there is an equivalence Phi : Ku(X1 ) -> Ku(X2 ) (of Fourier-Mukai type). Is it true that X1 and X2 are birational?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X_1$ and $X_2$ be smooth prime Fano threefolds of Picard rank one, index one, and degree ten over the complex numbers (so in particular each $X_i$ is a Gushel–Mukai threefold). For a smooth Gushel–Mukai threefold $X$, the bounded derived category $D^b(X)$ admits a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$ D^b(X) = \langle \mathcal{K}u(X),\, \mathcal{E},\, \mathcal{O}_X \rangle, $$
where $\mathcal{E}$ is the rank-two tautological subbundle (pulled back from the Grassmannian under the Gushel embedding) and $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is the Kuznetsov component defined as the right orthogonal $\langle \mathcal{E}, \mathcal{O}_X \rangle^{\perp}$. Suppose that there exists an exact equivalence of triangulated categories
$$ \Phi : \mathcal{K}u(X_1) \longrightarrow \mathcal{K}u(X_2) $$
that is of Fourier–Mukai type (i.e., induced by a kernel object in $D^b(X_1 \times X_2)$ in the appropriate sense for admissible subcategories). Must $X_1$ and $X_2$ be birational?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Jacovskis–Lin–Liu–Zhang and related papers) establishes that for smooth Gushel–Mukai threefolds, an equivalence $\mathcal{K}u(X_1)\simeq\mathcal{K}u(X_2)$ implies that $X_1$ and $X_2$ are period partners or duals, and hence birational, confirming the Kuznetsov–Perry birational categorical Torelli conjecture in this case. The question therefore appears affirmatively resolved.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems for Gushel-Mukai threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: For GM threefolds, Ku(X1) ≃ Ku(X2) if and only if X1 and X2 are period partners or duals; in particular they are birational.
status_evidence.claim: The birational categorical Torelli question for GM threefolds is answered affirmatively.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Ku(X) determines the birational isomorphism class of X for general ordinary GM threefolds.
status_evidence.claim: Equivalence of Kuznetsov components implies birationality for GM threefolds.
